summary: Maravai LifeSciences Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary entered into a new credit agreement on June 2, 2026, providing a $150.0M term loan and a $30.0M revolver maturing in 2032. Proceeds and cash on hand were used to repay and terminate the prior 2020 credit facility. Borrowings are secured by substantially all assets and bear interest at SOFR plus 5.00%, with a potential 25bp stepdown. This is a routine refinancing of existing debt, not a special situation.
